name: Federal Award Noncompliance Awareness Notice
description: Employees, contractors and subrecipients are made aware that noncompliance may lead to additional conditions or termination of the award.
recipient: Employees, contractors and subrecipients in federally funded programs
quote: Employees and contractors involved in federally funded programs and sub-recipients shall be made aware that failure to comply with federal law, regulations, or terms and conditions of a federal award may result in the federal awarding agency or pass-through entity imposing additional conditions or terminating the award in whole or in part.
